startDate.description: Start date of requested time frame of the accounts performance; format should follow 2019-07-08 or 2019-07-08T00:00:00Z

endDate.description: End date of requested time frame of the accounts performance; format should follow 2019-07-08 or 2019-07-08T00:00:00Z

lastUpdated.description: Date and time of last performance update

clientMemberId.description: Unique client-side identifier for the member

name.description: The name of the client organization

realizedDayPL.description: The actual profit or loss on the day in USD

unrealizedDayPL.description: Unrealized day profit and loss for the position

cumRealizedPL.description: The cumulative realized profit/loss from inception of account, each day adds to previous days

date.description: The date of the performance array values

equity.description: Invested equity (excluding cash) for this day (see performance.date). For Total Equity add performance equity and performance cash.
